thread:
maria: seeing a weird mismatch between Kibana and Loki for requests to /v1/generate in us-west1. Kibana shows nothing for trace 8f3a2c, Loki shows spans. anyone else?

ajay: are you searching the right index? we recently changed the alias from logs-prod-* to logs-ingest-2026-* in us-west cluster.

maria: i used the same query that works in eu-west. pasted below. no hits in kibana for traceId=8f3a2c in us-west.

maria: ```kql
service:"inference-gateway" and trace.id:"8f3a2c" and http.request.path: "/v1/generate"
```

ryan: on Loki side i can see entries with trace_id=8f3a2c in the us-west loki-01 stream. looks like the log-forwarder to ES is failing for that tenant/region.

leia: any recent deploys to vector/forwarder? we had a config change for index templates last week.

ajay: i just checked fleet, vector was rotated on 2026-05-03 02:14 UTC in us-west; logs show occasional 413s when batching big requests. maybe those events were dropped.

maria: hmm, the trace exists in jaeger as well (span id 0a7e4f). jaeger->loki link ok, so sketch: trace -> spans -> loki ok, ES ingest failing.

ryan: quick sanity checks: can you run this curl against the ES alias in us-west? might get 404 if alias mispointed.

ryan: ```bash
curl -sS -u readonly:XXXX "https://es-us-west.redwood.internal/logs-ingest-*/_search?q=trace.id:8f3a2c&size=1" | jq '.'
```

maria: ran it, returned: `{
  "error": {"root_cause": [{"type":"index_not_found_exception","reason":"no such index"}],"type":"index_not_found_exception"}`

leia: that confirms alias mismatch. where is the alias pointing in eu-west?

ajay: eu-west alias points at `logs-prod-2026-05` while us-west alias got rotated to `logs-ingest-2026-05` during the last template rollout. operator error.

maria: can we create a temporary alias to fix search for the oncall incident? i need to pull the full request/response for the user-reported error.

ryan: i'll create a read-only alias `logs-query` that returns last 72h indices in us-west and eu-west. creating now.

sre-bot: deploy job vector-forwarder/us-west rotated at 2026-05-03T02:14:21Z; status: success; warnings: 3 (batch_size).

ryan: alias created. try the same curl but query `logs-query`.

maria: `curl ... "https://es-us-west.redwood.internal/logs-query/_search?q=trace.id:8f3a2c&size=200" returned 18 hits, pulling and attaching sample. looks like some events have `ingest.status:failed` with message `document_too_large`.

leia: that matches the 413s ajay saw. Vector had no retry for 413. we can add backoff and chunking in the config.

ajay: quick mitigation: enable a pipeline that truncates oversized payloads to avoid total drop, and set vector to split multiline fields. I'll open a PR to patch vector config and roll a hotfix.

maria: for the immediate user investigation, the alias fix is enough. thanks. next steps: patch vector, add alert for ES index_not_found when queries hit production dashboards, and add a Loki->ES ingest metric.

ryan: adding alert: "es.alias_missing_or_empty" with threshold >0 hits in last 10m for prod dashboards. also will add Grafana panel for `vector_outcomes_total{outcome="dropped"}` per region.

leia: also add an SLO check: percent of traces with at least one ES document indexed within 10s of span completion. if that falls below 99.5% for a region, alert.

maria: can someone follow up with infra to backfill any dropped logs for the affected tenant? we'll need these for debugging the request repro.

ajay: i'll take backfill. may need to rehydrate from Loki to ES for that trace range. will script it.

maria: thanks all — resolving for now. tagging this thread for postmortem notes. :white_check_mark:

leia: jotting down action items: 1) vector hotfix PR 2) alias stable naming policy 3) Grafana alerts + SLO 4) backfill script 5) runbook update for cross-region query troubleshooting

ryan: leaving a small query snippet for future use:

ryan: ```loki
{app="inference-gateway", region="us-west"} |= "trace_id=8f3a2c" | json | line_format "{trace_id} {request_path} {status_code}"
```

maria: saved. thanks everyone.
